title: Inverse Learning of the Altruism and Cost Level in Mixed-Individual Mean Field Games
abstract: arXiv:2609.13469v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Understanding how humans respond to incentives, both at the individual and collective levels, is crucial to the design of effective policies. Within the continuous-time stochastic framework for large interacting populations, mean field games (MFGs) model populations of non-cooperative agents, whereas mean field control (MFC) describes the fully cooperative benchmark, interpreted in our setting as fully altruistic behavior. Mixed-individual MFGs interpolate between these two extremes through a parameter governing the degree of altruism. A central challenge for regulators and policymakers, however, is that intrinsic altruism levels and other private structural parameters, such as individual labor costs, are typically unobservable. To address this challenge, we develop an inverse learning framework for mixed-individual MFGs. translated_title: 混合个体平均场博弈中利他主义与成本水平的逆学习
translated_abstract: 理解人类如何在个体和集体层面响应激励，对于设计有效的政策至关重要。在大规模交互群体的连续时间随机框架中，平均场博弈（MFGs）用于建模由非合作智能体组成的群体，而平均场控制（MFC）则描述了完全合作的基准情形，在我们的设定中被解释为完全利他的行为。混合个体平均场博弈通过一个控制利他程度的参数在这两个极端之间进行插值。然而，对于监管者和政策制定者而言，一个核心挑战在于：内在的利他水平以及其他私人结构性参数（如个体劳动成本）通常是不可观测的。为应对这一挑战，我们为混合个体平均场博弈开发了一个逆学习框架。我们的方法能够从带噪声的观测数据中恢复（潜在的）利他主义程度和劳动成本水平，并通过实验验证了……
tldr: 该论文针对混合个体平均场博弈提出了一个逆学习框架，能够从带噪声的观测数据中恢复不可观测的利他主义程度和劳动成本水平，为政策制定者理解群体激励机制提供了新工具。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an inverse learning framework for mixed-individual mean field games, enabling the recovery of latent altruism levels and labor costs from noisy observations, providing policymakers with a new tool for understanding group incentive mechanisms.
